## Void Deck 1.1.1

**The on-screen keyboard is fixed.** Steam names its keyboard elements differently on the Steam Deck than on the ASUS ROG Ally and other handhelds, so Void Deck was writing rules that matched nothing and the keyboard kept Steam's own background. It now finds the keyboard however Steam names it, and the keys get the Void Deck treatment on every device.

**Scrollbars now match.** Everything Steam scrolls through — lists, menus and settings — gets the same slim flat scrollbar as the rest of the interface.

**Menus cleaned up.** Focus rings, settings rows and the sections of the STEAM menu now share one consistent look: flat panels, hairline rules, and the accent colour where you expect it. The white ring of the light theme, which was invisible on a light surface, now reads clearly.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v1.1.1.zip` from this release.
